explanation: I searched Mathlib for `traceOfFiniteProjective`, `trace_prodMap`, `trace_coprod` and block-matrix trace lemmas. Mathlib has no trace for finite projective modules. `LinearMap.trace` in `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Trace.lean` is defined through bases and is 0 when there is no finite basis. It is a different object. `trace_prodMap` and `trace_prodMap'` cover only the diagonal case `f.prodMap g`, not the block-matrix `(f.prod k).coprod (h.prod g)`. They also concern `trace`, not `traceOfFiniteProjective`. I found no declaration that states this result or yields it in one or two lines.
